name: WAYA
source:
WAYA is a short visual novel created for O2A2 2023 Queer Edition in which you play as a lonesome scientist who lives with her robot assistant and try to diagnose whatever's bugging her.

[From [url=https://radiokiro.itch.io/waya]Itch.io[/url]]
